iZ-Gf4kLcng7kDQGmXF1XQ.zh: 疫情更新:  今年第 12 週(3/23-29)全球陽性率略升為 1.84%,其中東南亞區署、東地中海區署陽性率明顯增加。  韓國今年第 14 週增加 45 例住院病例,與前 1 週相當,疫情處低點,惟陽性率已連續4週上升,自 3 月起之變異株占比改以 BA.3.2 為主(45%)、其次為 NB.1.8.1(占 41%)。  阿拉伯聯合大公國疫情快速上升,第 12 週陽性率上升為 8.82%,為東地中海疫情上升之主要國家。  評估與建議:  近期全球流行變異株以 XFG 占比最高(占 40.62%),其次為NB.1.8.1(占 26.04%),BA.3.2 占比上升至 12.5%。WHO 公布之COVID-19 全球長期快速風險評估(第 9 版),評估對全球公共衛生的整體風險屬中等。鑒於自然感染與疫苗帶來的群體免疫力提升,以及臨床治療的進步,全球住院與死亡數自 2022 年以來明顯下降。 目前多數流行變異株為 Omicron JN.1 及其衍生亞型,雖具備免疫逃脫能力,但不至於造成疾病嚴重度增加,惟有 6%之有症狀病例出現長新冠症狀;現階段 COVID-19 尚未形成穩定季節性流行規律,多數國家已減少常規檢測通報,汙水與定醫監測成為重要的補充監測方式。 WHO 指出,目前疫苗仍能有效預防重症與死亡,並建議優先保護高風險族群、與流感疫苗共同施打;同時透過《冠狀病毒疾病威脅管理策略計劃》呼籲各國整合防治計畫,持續加強監測、保護高風險族群、維持醫療與公衛韌性,並落實風險溝通。
iZ-Gf4kLcng7kDQGmXF1XQ.en: Update: In week 12 (23–29 March), the global positivity rate rose slightly to 1.84%, with marked increases in the WHO regional offices for South-East Asia and the Eastern Mediterranean. In week 14 of the year, South Korea added 45 hospitalised cases, similar to the previous week; the outbreak is at a low point, but positivity has risen for four consecutive weeks. Since March, the main variant has shifted to BA.3.2 (45%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (41%). The United Arab Emirates' outbreak is rising rapidly: positivity rose to 8.82% in week 12, making it the main country in the Eastern Mediterranean with rising outbreaks. Assessment and recommendations: recently circulating variants are led by XFG (40.62%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (26.04%), and BA.3.2 has risen to 12.5%. WHO's COVID-19 Global Long-term Rapid Risk Assessment (9th edition) rates the overall risk to global public health as moderate. Given population immunity from natural infection and vaccination, and advances in clinical treatment, global hospitalisations and deaths have declined markedly since 2022. Most circulating variants are Omicron JN.1 and its descendant subvariants; although they have immune escape capacity, they do not cause greater severity, but 6% of symptomatic cases have long COVID symptoms. No stable seasonal pattern has yet formed for COVID-19, and most countries have reduced routine testing and reporting, so wastewater and sentinel clinic surveillance have become important supplementary tools. WHO notes that vaccines remain effective at preventing severe disease and death, and recommends prioritising protection of high-risk groups and co-administration with influenza vaccines. Through its coronavirus disease threat management strategic plan, WHO calls on countries to integrate prevention and control plans, continue strengthening surveillance, protect high-risk groups, maintain health system and public health resilience, and implement risk communication.

AB8BAPN3ITYf3E6CKBN2XA.zh: 馬達加斯加報告首起疫情,西北部馬哈贊加市共計報告5例確定病例,病患皆接受治療中,當局已啟動緊急公衛行動中心,加強疫情監測及港口/機場等入境點之健康檢查作業,該國醫療系統資源有限,倘疫情擴散,可能限制診斷、治療及疫苗接種的因應能力。 以色列報告首例1b型境外移入病例,該病患具阿拉伯聯合大公國(UAE)旅遊史,當局已啟動疫情監測及接觸者追蹤作業,惟該國疫苗短缺已持續6個月,致無法及時提供高風險族群疫苗,呼籲民眾倘出現疑症狀,應立即接受檢測。
AB8BAPN3ITYf3E6CKBN2XA.en: Madagascar reported its first outbreak. In Mahajanga city in northwestern Madagascar, a total of 5 confirmed cases have been reported, and all are receiving treatment. Authorities have activated an emergency public health operations centre and strengthened surveillance and health screening at entry points such as ports and airports. The country's healthcare system has limited resources, and if the outbreak spreads, its capacity for diagnosis, treatment and vaccination may be restricted. Israel reported its first imported clade Ib case. The patient had travelled to the United Arab Emirates. Authorities have activated surveillance and contact tracing. However, the country has had a vaccine shortage for six months, so high-risk groups cannot be vaccinated in a timely manner. People with suspicious symptoms are urged to get tested immediately.

TVHPzEM8IwAMP6va5L0eXA.zh: 希臘11/1報告該國首例Ib型境外移入病例,該病患曾具阿拉伯聯合大公國(UAE)旅遊史,並發生MSM行為。歐洲6國於10/11-20期間報告至少8例I型病例,分別為德國/義大利各2例、比利時/荷蘭/葡萄牙/西班牙各1例,其中2例不具旅遊史,其中3例為MSM族群,顯示可能在同性/雙性族群中尚有未發現的社交傳播鏈。當局評估MSM族群傳播風險為中,一般民眾為低。 英國自2022年截至今年10/31已累計3,732例病例,其中,累計18例Ib型病例,大多數病例與前往Ib型流行國家有直/間接關聯,該國於11/3新增報告1例Ib型病例,即具泰國旅遊史。由於近期歐、美洲MSM族群傳播風險升高,當局評估將該病輸入傳播風險從中提升至高。
TVHPzEM8IwAMP6va5L0eXA.en: Greece reported on 1 November its first imported clade Ib case; the patient had a travel history to the United Arab Emirates (UAE) and had engaged in MSM behaviour. Between 11 and 20 October, six European countries reported at least eight clade Ib cases: Germany and Italy 2 each, and Belgium, the Netherlands, Portugal and Spain 1 each. Two of these cases had no travel history, and three were in the MSM population, suggesting that undetected social transmission chains may exist among men who have sex with men and bisexual populations. Authorities assess the transmission risk in the MSM population as moderate and for the general public as low. The United Kingdom has recorded 3,732 cases cumulatively since 2022 as of 31 October this year, including 18 clade Ib cases, most of which are directly or indirectly linked to travel to countries with clade Ib transmission. The UK reported one new clade Ib case on 3 November, with a travel history to Thailand. Because the transmission risk among MSM in Europe and the Americas has recently increased, authorities have raised the assessed risk of importation and spread from moderate to high.

jG7wccqpOab5MtoF1b1NTw.zh: 全球本月疫情更新:  自2022年5月截至今年8/28累計139國/地區報告15萬8,000餘例確診病例,其中至少399例死亡(CFR:0.2%)。 今年截至第35週累計84國/地區報告3萬7千餘例確診病例,其中非洲區3萬1,980例、美洲區2,825例、歐洲區1,858例、西太平洋區1,067例、東南亞區82例及東地中海區33例。西太平洋疫情上升,歸因於中國、菲律賓今年7月單月新增皆逾100例病例。  其他更新:   肯亞疫情上升,自2024年7月報告首例病例截至今年8/17累計370例確診,其中6例死亡,死亡個案中有5例為HIV患者。病患多集中於該國東南方第二大港口城市蒙巴薩,病患過半數為20-40歲年輕人,該國近45%縣(21/47)皆報告病例,性接觸傳播為主要擴大因素,尤其是東非主要跨國公路之卡車司機、性工作者及商販等。 中國於8/1報告新增1例Ib型病例,為成年男性旅遊者,於7月中旬入境時回報症狀,當局展開疫調並採防範措施。另澳門於8/27報告今年首例境外移入病例,為該區自2023年第3例病例(前2例於2023年報告)。病患為29歲澳門男性居民,於8/23出現發熱、咽痛及腹瀉等症狀,曾於內地就診,26日返澳就醫確診,病患曾在旅遊時發生高風險性行為,惟未透露地點。 德國於8/19報告新增1例Ib型病例,為成年男性旅遊者,具阿拉伯聯合大公國(UAE)旅遊史,當局已追蹤接觸者並監測症狀。 土耳其報告3例Ib型病例,近期報告1例為7月下旬時確診,具阿拉伯聯合大公國(UAE)及埃及旅遊史,餘2例為回溯型病例,具烏干達旅遊史,當局已採疫調及隔離相關措施。 剛果民主共和國首次報告2例IIb型確診病例,指標個案為成年男性,具象牙海岸旅遊史,經分析該序列與象牙海岸及奈及利亞之病例相;案2為指標個案之接觸者,當局匡列25名接觸者追蹤,其中23名接種暴露後疫苗。該國首次檢出IIb型病例,顯示IIb型已進入Ia/Ib型流行區域,公共風險增加。  評估與建議: WHO宣布原定於2025/8/20到期之長期建議措施,因應全球流行病學情勢,將再延長1年,以預防及減少國際傳播及其對健康之影響。強調「持續監測、科學研究、社區合作與公平資源分配」是2025–26年全球防控核心,7大面向建議包括:國家防治計畫與政策持續優化、建立監測與實驗室診斷能力、加強社區保護與風險溝通、推動研究與臨床試驗、制定旅行相關措施(不鼓勵旅行禁令)、提供最佳臨床照護與醫護防護、確保公平獲得疫苗/診斷/治療。
jG7wccqpOab5MtoF1b1NTw.en: Global monthly outbreak update: since May 2022 and as of 28 August this year, 139 countries and territories have cumulatively reported more than 158,000 confirmed cases, of which at least 399 died (CFR: 0.2%). This year, as of week 35, 84 countries and territories have cumulatively reported more than 37,000 confirmed cases: African Region 31,980; Region of the Americas 2,825; European Region 1,858; Western Pacific Region 1,067; South-East Asia Region 82; and Eastern Mediterranean Region 33. The rise in the Western Pacific is attributed to China and the Philippines each reporting more than 100 new cases in July this year alone. Other updates: Kenya's outbreak is rising. Since the first case was reported in July 2024, 370 confirmed cases have been cumulatively reported as of 17 August this year, including 6 deaths, five of which were in people living with HIV. Cases are concentrated in Mombasa, the country's second-largest port city in the south-east. More than half of patients are young adults aged 20–40. About 45% of the country's counties (21 of 47) have reported cases. Sexual transmission is the main driver of spread, particularly among truck drivers, sex workers and traders along the main East African transnational highway. China reported one new clade Ib case on 1 August: an adult male traveller who reported symptoms upon entry in mid-July. Authorities launched an epidemiological investigation and preventive measures. Macao reported its first imported case of this year on 27 August, the third case in the region since 2023 (the first two were reported in 2023). The patient is a 29-year-old male Macao resident who developed fever, sore throat and diarrhoea on 23 August. He had sought care on the mainland and returned to Macao for treatment on 26 August, where the infection was confirmed. The patient had high-risk sexual behaviour during travel, but did not disclose the location. Germany reported one new clade Ib case on 19 August: an adult male traveller with a travel history to the United Arab Emirates. Authorities have traced contacts and are monitoring symptoms. Turkey reported three clade Ib cases. One recent case was confirmed in late July and had a travel history to the UAE and Egypt; the other two were retrospective cases with a travel history to Uganda. Authorities have conducted epidemiological investigation and isolation measures. The Democratic Republic of the Congo reported its first two confirmed clade IIb cases. The index case is an adult male with a travel history to Côte d'Ivoire; analysis shows the sequence matches cases in Côte d'Ivoire and Nigeria. Case 2 is a contact of the index case; authorities have traced 25 contacts, 23 of whom received post-exposure vaccination. This is the country's first detection of clade IIb, indicating that clade IIb has entered areas where clade Ia/Ib circulates, increasing public risk. Assessment and recommendations: WHO announced that the long-term recommended measures, originally due to expire on 20 August 2025, will be extended by one year in view of the global epidemiological situation, to prevent and reduce international transmission and its health impact. It emphasizes that continued surveillance, scientific research, community cooperation and equitable resource allocation are the core of global prevention and control for 2025–26. Seven areas of recommendation are: continued optimization of national plans and policies; building surveillance and laboratory diagnostic capacity; strengthening community protection and risk communication; promoting research and clinical trials; formulating travel-related measures (travel bans are not encouraged); providing optimal clinical care and health-worker protection; and ensuring equitable access to vaccines, diagnostics and treatment.

INK9QIjivlSTTc5aJxESkg.zh: 本月更新:  全球自2022年6月截至今年7/25累計139國/地區報告15萬4千餘例確診病例,其中至少385例死亡(CFR:0.2%)。 全球今年截至第30週累計79國/地區報告3萬3,370例確診病例,其中非洲區2萬8,481例、美洲區2,343例、歐洲區1,706例、西太平洋區755例、東南亞區52例及東地中海區33例。  其他更新:  中國今年截至7/31報告23例Ib型確診病例,其中7例具疫區旅遊史,包含烏干達(2例)、坦尚亞(2例)、剛果民主共和國(2例)、西非國家(剛果、馬利),另2例具泊爾及1例具阿拉伯聯合大公國旅遊史,其餘個案為本土傳播,其中,包含居住在中國之非洲僑民。WHO基於所有通報群聚事件中,指標個案均能與旅遊史有流行病學關聯,故將該國傳播分類由「未知傳播鏈」更正為「與旅遊相關個案」,惟仍無法排除尚未偵測到之社區傳播可能性。當局已在疫區進行廢水監測,並加強衛教及提供無症狀者藥物。 澳大利亞7/19報告新增2例Ib型病例,案1近期有烏干達旅遊史,案2為案1家庭接觸者,當局已加強監測疫情。 英國7/22新增1例Ib型病例,為成年男性,具肯亞旅遊史,當局已展開疫調與監測,並提供接觸者疫苗。  評估與建議: WHO於2025年6月5日召開國際衛生條例(IHR)緊急委員會第四次會議,討論2024年M痘疫情上升的情形。會議確認該事件仍構成國際關注公共衛生緊急事件(PHEIC),並針對受影響國家提出各項臨時建議,包括加強監測、提升診斷能力、推動疫苗接種、改善臨床護理、強化跨境合作,以及加強社區參與和資金支持,並將現行建議延長至2025年8月20日。
INK9QIjivlSTTc5aJxESkg.en: Monthly update: since June 2022 and as of 25 July this year, 139 countries and territories have cumulatively reported more than 154,000 confirmed cases, of which at least 385 died (CFR: 0.2%). This year, as of week 30, 79 countries and territories have cumulatively reported 33,370 confirmed cases: African Region 28,481; Region of the Americas 2,343; European Region 1,706; Western Pacific Region 755; South-East Asia Region 52; and Eastern Mediterranean Region 33. Other updates: China reported 23 confirmed clade Ib cases as of 31 July this year, of which seven had travel history to affected areas, including Uganda (2), Tanzania (2), the DRC (2), and West African countries (Congo, Mali); two had travel history to Nepal and one to the UAE. The other cases were locally transmitted, including African nationals living in China. Based on all reported clusters in which the index cases had epidemiological links to travel, WHO has reclassified China's transmission category from 'unknown transmission chain' to 'travel-associated cases', although undetected community transmission cannot be ruled out. Authorities have launched wastewater surveillance in affected areas, strengthened health education, and provided medicines to asymptomatic people. Australia reported two new clade Ib cases on 19 July: case 1 had recent travel history to Uganda, and case 2 was a household contact of case 1; authorities have strengthened surveillance. The UK reported one new clade Ib case on 22 July, an adult male with travel history to Kenya; authorities have launched epidemiological investigation and surveillance and provided vaccines to contacts. Assessment and recommendations: WHO held the fourth meeting of the IHR Emergency Committee on 5 June 2025 to discuss the rise in mpox since 2024. The meeting confirmed that the event still constitutes a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), and issued temporary recommendations for affected countries, including strengthening surveillance, improving diagnostic capacity, promoting vaccination, improving clinical care, strengthening cross-border cooperation, and enhancing community engagement and financial support. Current recommendations were extended to 20 August 2025.

QHfk-KVN167ZcwmRdfmIMA.zh: WHO於2/13公布:  阿拉伯聯合大公國於2/7報告該國首例Ib型確診病例,具烏干達旅遊史,1/11出現症狀,18日確診,目前隔離治療中。迄今已累計7例自該國之輸出病例(3例泰國、中國/阿曼/巴基斯坦/印度各1例),推測該國可能有未知之社區傳播鏈。 中國自1/3起截至2/5累計7例Ib型確診病例,首例為1/3報告,具剛果民主共和國旅遊史,二次傳播至其餘5人;另1起為1/21報告新增1例病例,具阿拉伯聯合大公國旅遊史。
QHfk-KVN167ZcwmRdfmIMA.en: WHO reported on 13 February that the United Arab Emirates reported its first clade Ib confirmed case on 7 February, with a travel history to Uganda. Symptoms began on 11 January and the case was confirmed on 18 January; the patient is in isolation for treatment. So far, 7 exported cases from the UAE have been recorded: 3 in Thailand, and 1 each in China, Oman, Pakistan and India. Authorities suspect there may be an unknown community transmission chain in the UAE. Mainland China has reported 7 clade Ib confirmed cases cumulatively from 3 January to 5 February. The first case, reported on 3 January, had a travel history to the Democratic Republic of the Congo and transmitted the virus to 5 others. Another case, reported on 21 January, was newly added and had a travel history to the UAE.

uuYDZYLcy1oeDvK_iE1fLg.zh: WHO於12/23報告巴基斯坦通報由阿拉伯聯合大公國移入該國之首例Ib分支個案,病例為男性,於11月下旬出現症狀就醫確診;阿曼亦通報1例由阿拉伯聯合大公國移入該國之首例I型(待定分支)個案,為男性,11/30出現症狀,12/9確診。
uuYDZYLcy1oeDvK_iE1fLg.en: WHO reported on 23 December that Pakistan had notified its first clade Ib case imported from the United Arab Emirates. The patient is a man who developed symptoms in late November, sought medical care and was confirmed. Oman also notified one case of clade I (subclade undetermined) imported from the United Arab Emirates, the first such case in Oman. The patient is a man who developed symptoms on 30 November and was confirmed on 9 December.
